Booked on South Carolina State Parks' own reservation site or 1-866-345-7275, up to 13 months ahead. 'Minimum length of stay is 2 nights'; per AWH's firsthand report on the state:SC row, a single night can be booked by calling the park within a week of arrival. Maximum 14 nights (cumulative up to 42 of 49). Same-day reservations go through the park (864-638-5353). Check-in 2 pm, check-out noon.
